headline: Reddit’s AI is turning posts into podcasts and short videos
summary: Reddit is experimenting with AI to convert text posts into audio/video content. AI voices read post texts and comments for new video formats. This initiative aims to offer new ways to consume Reddit content.

headline: ABC's livestreamed news show is powered by trending topics
summary: ABC News launched 'Searched,' a new livestreamed show. It focuses on stories trending on social media and web searches. The show airs on ABC News Live, including Disney Plus.

headline: This compact Glorious mechanical keyboard is just $35
summary: The Glorious GMMK 3 mechanical keyboard is on sale for $34.99 at Woot. This 65-percent keyboard is ideal for those new to custom keyboards. Use coupon code WOOTGAMING for the discounted price.

headline: Wordle meets Clippy in this new word game
summary: A new word game, Dartwords, is inspired by Wordle and Microsoft's Clippy. Designed by Sam Rosenthal, creative director at The Game Band. It explores new possibilities within the daily word game format.

headline: ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor is on Sale
summary: The ASUS ZenScreen portable monitor is currently on sale. It functions as a secondary display for laptops. Also great as a portable screen for Nintendo Switch or Steam Deck.

headline: James Gunn Defends DCU Tonal Shift After Lanterns Controversy
summary: James Gunn defended the DCU's varied tonal approach. This follows discussion sparked by the gritty 'Lanterns' first episode. Gunn clarifies the DCU will not adhere to a single tone.

headline: Amazon's Game of Thrones T-Shirt Sale Features House of the Dragon Designs
summary: Amazon is running a sale on Game of Thrones T-shirts. The sale includes popular House of the Dragon designs. Fans can find themed apparel from the popular series.

headline: 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV Drops to $1,198
summary: The 65-inch Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV is now $1,198 on Amazon. This model was named the best gaming TV in 2026. The deal includes free shipping.

headline: IVF Staff Accused of Misleading UK Parents on Donor Information in Cyprus
summary: IVF staff in northern Cyprus are accused of misleading UK parents. Concerns arise over children conceived with unselected sperm and egg donors. Multiple families may have received incorrect donor information.

headline: Russia Says UK 'Will Pay' for Supplying Drones to Ukraine
summary: Russia warned the UK it would 'pay' for supplying drones to Ukraine. An MoD spokesperson affirmed Britain's support for Ukraine. The statement escalates tensions over military aid.

headline: Fifa Official Sacked After Criticizing Infantino Plan
summary: Senior Fifa figure Kevin Lamour was sacked by football's governing body. His dismissal follows criticism of president Gianni Infantino's plans. The sacking occurred three weeks after his public comments.

headline: Germany Targets Small Boats Gangs with Raids on Secret Warehouses
summary: German authorities raided a secret warehouse targeting smuggling gangs. Dinghies and life jackets were seized in the operation. This is part of new laws cracking down on human trafficking.
